Refutation of reconcile cleavage_agent_unsupported (false positive): the record does name trypsin as the digest reagent - PRIDE sampleProcessingProtocol / paper 2.5: "The gel pieces were saturated with 13 ng/uL sequence-grade modified trypsin in 10 mM ABC, 10% ACN and the tubes were incubated at 37 C overnight." That sentence contains none of record_reconcile._DIGEST_CUE's patterns ('overnight at 37' is matched only in that word order; 'in-gel' appears in another sentence), so proteases_in_record() returns nothing. Trypsin is also MaxQuant's enzyme (Trypsin/P rule, summary.txt). No other finding.
